Ava_CSM: Proposal for CumulusPay: small perf pilot — int8 quant + regional warm-pool routing. Aim: cut median latency by ~20% and reduce token spend ~15%. Renewal Q4, possible upsell.
Ravi_SE: Agree. Customer cares about answer fidelity. Recommend 5-10% canary, blind eval on 300 prompts, automatic fallback to fp16 variant.
Nora_RE: Baseline numbers from last week: p50=225ms, p95=640ms, median seq=130, 95th seq=380. Heavy traffic window 02:00 UTC.
Ravi_SE: Canary YAML (draft):
```yaml
traffic_split: 0.08
model_variant: cumulus-v3-int8
fallback: cumulus-v3-fp16
sample_capture: true
monitoring: [latency,error_rate,output_similarity]
```
ops_bot: Canary started for cumulus-v3-int8 -> 8% traffic at 3137770020. Dashboard: canary/3137770000.
ops_bot: Update: 45m in, error rate stable, p50 down 21%, p95 down 10%. No alerts.
Ava_CSM: I'll get customer sign-off on sampled prompts and share a rollback SLA (1h). Preparing one-slide summary for renewal.
Ravi_SE: I'll export sample outputs and queue a blind eval job. If eval shows >1% quality delta we'll abort.
Ava_CSM: Great, thanks — keep me posted and I'll draft the customer note once we have the sample set.
__notes: Short CS+Eng thread coordinating a cautious int8 quantization and routing canary for a renewal account. Includes a small YAML snippet and bot updates.
